entry.name: array.union
entry.digest: Combine two arrays into a new array object containing non-duplicate entries of both arrays
entry.description: Combine two arrays into a new array object containing non-duplicate entries of both arrays. For instance, the arrays [ 0, 1, 1, 2, 8 ] and [ 2, 2, 3, 3, 5 ] would become a new array [ 0, 1, 2, 8, 3, 5 ].
